_TitleUI.titleGroup.Enable = true
_EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/TabBar/BtnSkill'):SendEvent(ButtonClickEvent())
local expected = {[1]="08045b10680244309265e625d2281017",[2]="b4c023d8f92e4bc4b2e3fb954ae3ce68",[3]="7e3d9a36aa45453c9bf027414eafe2a5"}
local counts = {0,0,0}
for i=0,_SkillInventory.skillCount-1 do
 local slot = _SkillUI.skillScroll.Entity:GetChildByName('SkillSlot_' .. tostring(i))
 local grade = _SkillInventory:GetSkillGrade(i)
 assert(slot:GetChildByName('Bg').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId == expected[grade],'Grade frame mismatch index=' .. tostring(i))
 assert(slot:GetChildByName('Icon').UITransformComponent.RectSize.x == 118,'Icon size changed')
 assert(slot:GetChildByName('Bg').UITransformComponent.RectSize.y == 280,'Card height changed')
 counts[grade] = counts[grade]+1
end
log('[SkillGradeQA] allLiveSlots=' .. tostring(_SkillInventory.skillCount) .. ' normal=' .. tostring(counts[1]) .. ' magic=' .. tostring(counts[2]) .. ' rare=' .. tostring(counts[3]))

for i=0,_SkillInventory.skillCount-1 do

 if slot.Enable then
  assert(_SkillInventory:GetSkillGrade(i)==1,'Filtering changed')
  assert(slot:GetChildByName('Bg').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId=="08045b10680244309265e625d2281017",'Filtered frame')
  n=n+1
 end
end
assert(n>0,'Empty grade')
log('[SkillGradeQA] filtered=normal count=' .. tostring(n))
